summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1/node2/node3 (Alpine Linux) with node1 as initial primary and node2/node3 as async standbys, using a generated replicator role for basebackup/streaming auth. Demonstrated failover by stopping node1, promoting node2 to writable primary (pg_ctl promote), confirmed zero committed-data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, and rebuilt the recovered node1 as a standby of node2 via fresh pg_basebackup. Final steady state: node2 = writable primary, node1 & node3 = streaming standbys of node2. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, then node3, then node2 last since it was primary), proving changed boot_id on each and confirming full replication/cluster health and data integrity after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql16/postgresql16-contrib on node1, node2, node3
Initialized primary DB on node1, configured wal_level/max_wal_senders/pg_hba for replication
Generated replicator role with a randomly generated password on node1 (passed via secret_env, never in commands/report)
Created baseline_check table with a marker row for data-integrity tracking
Built node2 and node3 as standbys via pg_basebackup -R from node1, started them, confirmed streaming and marker row present
Inserted a second committed row on node1 and confirmed replication to both standbys before disruption
Stopped postgresql on node1 to simulate primary loss
Promoted node2 to writable primary via pg_ctl promote; verified pg_is_in_recovery=f and no data loss
Re-added replication config (wal_level, pg_hba) on node2 and reloaded
Repointed node3's primary_conninfo to node2 via ALTER SYSTEM + restart; confirmed streaming from node2 with all data
Rebuilt node1 as a fresh standby of node2 via pg_basebackup -R; confirmed pg_is_in_recovery=t and full data present
Verified final topology: node2 primary streaming to node1 and node3
Enabled postgresql in default runlevel on all three nodes
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health (pg_is_in_recovery, data rows) on all nodes

Restarted node1 (standby) first via `reboot`, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id and recovered standby streaming with data intact, re-enabled postgresql at boot since it wasn't in runlevel initially
Restarted node3 (standby) next, verified new boot_id and recovered standby streaming with data intact
Restarted node2 (primary) last, verified new boot_id, confirmed it returned as writable primary with data intact and both standbys reconnected

evidence.requirement: Baseline: node1 primary configured for replication, replicator role created, marker data written
evidence.summary: node1 initdb'd, configured for streaming replication, replicator role created, and baseline_check table populated with marker row

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 stood up as standbys of node1 and confirmed streaming with replicated data
evidence.summary: pg_basebackup -R completed on both nodes; pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both streaming; both standbys show pg_is_in_recovery=t and baseline row present

evidence.requirement: No committed data lost across failover
evidence.summary: Second row committed on node1 primary and confirmed replicated to both standbys prior to disruption; after promotion, node2 (new primary) still shows both rows plus new write, proving no data loss

evidence.requirement: Primary loss simulated and standby promoted to writable primary
evidence.summary: node1 postgresql stopped (simulated primary loss); node2 promoted via pg_ctl promote, pg_is_in_recovery=f, and successful write confirms it is now the writable primary

evidence.requirement: Other standby (node3) repointed to new primary (node2) and former primary (node1) rejoined as standby of node2
evidence.summary: node3 primary_conninfo repointed to node2, restarted, confirmed streaming with all data; node1 rebuilt via basebackup from node2 and started as standby, confirmed pg_is_in_recovery=t and full data present; node2 shows both node1 and node3 streaming

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline boot identity and health for all nodes
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id and pg_is_in_recovery status for node1 (a4302af0.., standby), node2 (9ddcfb0d.., primary), node3 (e58a9a8b.., standby) before any restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to f2fe9b46..; postgresql restarted, rejoined as standby with pg_is_in_recovery=t and all baseline_check rows present

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 0f3e14dd..; postgresql came back, standby recovery confirmed with full data; node2 pg_stat_replication shows node3 reconnected streaming

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state as primary with quorum restored
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to fac01568..; postgresql came back as writable primary (pg_is_in_recovery=f) with all data intact; both node1 and node3 confirmed reconnected as streaming standbys (pg_is_in_recovery=t on both)
